messages:
Lee (Marketing): quick kickoff 14 we need a one-page "Deployment Decider Brief" for the webinar next Tue. goal: help buyers pick Hosted / Dedicated / Private in under 45s. keep it scannable, shareable, and field-ready.
Ravi (Product): yes. include 3 short recommendation rows (security, SLA, cost), 2 benchmark callouts labeled 'example workload', and a one-line migration path.
Tess (Field): mandatory callouts: customer KMS/HSM support, VPC peering, retention windows for audit logs, and data residency notes. also add a tiny FinServ example.
Dana (Sales): inbound routing rules please: SDR vs. AE vs. SE. simple thresholds only. also short CTA for launch post: 15-min infra consult link. :rocket:
Lee (Marketing): suggested layout:
```
- Header: 1-sentence problem framing + Risk vs Speed vs Cost tag
- Body: 3-column table (Hosted | Dedicated | Private) / rows: Security, SLA & latency, Cost at scale, Time to ship
- Sidebars: 2 benchmark callouts + 3 persona micro-copy
- Footer: routing rules + webinar CTA
```
Ravi (Product): benchmark nuggets (example workload):
- Hosted (1k concurrent reqs, avg 128 tokens): 95th-pctl ~120ms
- Dedicated (reserved GPUs, 2M tokens/day): ~40% lower unit cost vs hosted for steady workloads
label both as "example workload". add note: runtime supports KV prefix caching and model fallbacks.
Tess (Field): persona micro-copy (one-liners):
- Platform Lead: "Dedicated gives predictable throughput and private networking."
- CISO: "Private with customer KMS + audit retention aligns with regulated controls."
- PM: "Hosted for rapid iteration with streaming and tool integrations."
Dana (Sales): inbound routing pseudo-rules (ops-friendly):
```yaml
# simple heuristics for routing
if security_barrier in ["requires_kms","requires_hsm","air_gapped"] or data_residency == true:
  route: AE+SE (high-touch)
elif projected_tokens_per_day >= 2_000_000 or expected_qps >= 1000:
  route: AE (dedicated)
else:
  route: SDR -> nurture (self-serve)
```
design-bot: uploaded 1746238888-deployment-brief-v0.pdf to thread.
Lee (Marketing): copy requirements: <120 words main blurb, clear two-tone header, accessible PDF and single-slide summary for field. use short bullets not paragraphs. keep claims conservative.
Ravi (Product): small tweak: for SLA language use "SLA-backed latency tiers" for Dedicated; for Hosted say "best-effort latency with multi-region fallback". also add a one-line migration path: Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private.
Tess (Field): adding FinServ example: "FinServ use-case: VPC + HSM + 99.9% uptime -> recommend Private." will paste exact wording into thread by EOD.
Dana (Sales): CTA copy suggestion for launch post: "Not sure which deployment fits your risk profile? Book a 15-min Infra consult: https://redwood.ai/book-demo". will prepare AE play snippet once copy locks.
Lee (Marketing): owners + timeline:
- Lee: draft one-pager and slide (by EOD today)
- Ravi: verify benchmarks + product bullets (tomorrow AM)
- Tess: field examples + discovery one-liners (tomorrow noon)
- Dana: routing rules to ops + AE snippet (tomorrow afternoon)
- Design: final assets after draft (24h turnaround)
Ravi (Product): ack. I'll confirm the example workload numbers and add tiny note about cache warming for cold starts.
Tess (Field): posting discovery one-liners now -> pasted.
Dana (Sales): noted. will send routing yaml to ops with comment thread.
Lee (Marketing): thanks team. aim to finalize for webinar pre-read on Friday. ping me for blockers or drop updated pdf into thread. :white_check_mark:
